messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into German, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE German line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑German Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------|--------| | Ond' | causal conjunction “wherefore / because” | **Denn** | “because” | OK | | io | 1st‑person singular pronoun (subject) | **ich** | “I” | OK | | per | preposition marking benefactive purpose | **zu** | “to/for” | OK | | lo | neuter definite article/pronoun (the) | *(part of “deinem”)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | tuo | 2nd‑person possessive adjective (your) | **deinem** | “your” (dative) | OK | | me' | abstract noun “best / good” | **Wohl** | “well‑being / good” | OK | | penso | verb “think” (cognitive) | **denke** | “think” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **und** | “and” | OK | | discerno | verb “deem, judge” (evaluative) | **urteile** | “judge” | OK | | che | subordinating conjunction “that” | **dass** | “that” | OK | | tu | 2nd‑person singular pronoun (subject) | **du** | “you” | OK | | mi | 1st‑person pronoun (object, dative) | **mir** | “me” (to me) | OK | | segui | verb “follow” (imperative‑like) | **folgst** | “follow” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **und** | “and” | OK | | io | 1st‑person singular pronoun (subject) | **ich** | “I” | OK | | sarò | future copular verb “will be” | **werde** | “will” (auxiliary) | OK | | tua | 2nd‑person possessive adjective (your) | **dein** | “your” | OK | | guida | noun “guide” (role) | **Führer** | “guide” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **und** | “and” | OK | | trarrotti | future transitive verb “will lead/bring” (to you) | **werde … hinausführen** | “will lead out” | OK | | di | preposition “from” | **von** | “from” | OK | | qui | adverb of place “here” | **hier** | “here” | OK | | per | preposition introducing destination “through / to” | **zum** | “to the” | OK | | loco | noun “place” (archaic) | **Ort** | “place” | OK | | etterno | adjective “eternal” | **ewigen** | “eternal” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *lo* – the definite article is absorbed into the German dative form *deinem* and does not appear as a separate word.
All other source tokens are represented adequately in the German translation, with correct grammatical agreement and appropriate lexical choices.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only German script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final German text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 112: - Original: **Denn ich denke und urteile dass es zu deinem Wohl ist** - Issue: missing comma before subordinate clause (“dass …”) - Corrected: **Denn ich denke und urteile, dass es zu deinem Wohl ist**
- Line 113: - Original: **dass du mir folgst und ich dein Führer sein werde,** - Issue: verb‑order error in main clause (“ich dein Führer sein werde”) - Corrected: **dass du mir folgst und ich werde dein Führer sein,**
- Line 114: - Original: **und ich werde dich von hier hinausführen zum ewigen Ort;** - Issue: none - Corrected: **no change**
``` Denn ich denke und urteile, dass es zu deinem Wohl ist dass du mir folgst und ich werde dein Führer sein, und ich werde dich von hier hinausführen zum ewigen Ort; ```
